fields.description: The applicant is presenting a site plan for 7503 Village Rd, showing the conversion of the space from a convenience store into a barber shop. The layout of the site will remain as it currently exists with all major modifications taking place inside of the building. All principle permitted uses in the B-L zone, where a building permit and zoning certificate are required, are also subject to a site plan review by the Planning Commission per Town Code §180-95.
